title: Sparse Second Order
text: Represent sparse second-order models in Simulink, 1 input, 1 output, {M (mass)} sets Mass matrix; {C (damping)} sets the damping, {K (stiffness)} sets the stiffness, {B} sets the input-to-state, {F} sets the displacement-to-output, {G} sets the velocity-to-output, {D} sets the input-to-output, {Initial position q(0)} sets the initial values for displacement vector and {Initial velocity q’(0)} sets the initial values for velocity vector. Values come from the instance.

params.name: M (mass)
params.values: Mass matrix 1 (default) | scalar | Nq -by- Nq sparse matrix

params.name: C (damping)
params.values: Damping matrix 0 (default) | scalar | Nq -by- Nq sparse matrix

params.name: K (stiffness)
params.values: Stiffness matrix 1 (default) | scalar | Nq -by- Nq sparse matrix

params.name: B
params.values: Input-to-state matrix 1 (default) | scalar | Nq -by- Nu sparse matrix

params.name: F
params.values: Displacement-to-output matrix 1 (default) | scalar | Ny -by- Nq sparse matrix

params.name: G
params.values: Velocity-to-output matrix 0 (default) | scalar | Ny -by- Nq sparse matrix

params.name: D
params.values: Input-to-output matrix 0 (default) | scalar | Ny -by- Nu sparse matrix

params.name: Initial position q(0)
params.values: Initial values for displacement vector 0 (default) | scalar | vector of doubles

params.name: Initial velocity q’(0)
params.values: Initial values for velocity vector 0 (default) | scalar | vector of doubles
